proposed_fixes.title: Reconcile FancyZones placement after secondary-display handshakes
proposed_fixes.root_cause: FancyZones may process a display notification before monitor bounds and taskbar work area settle, then use intermediate geometry for saved zone placement.
plan: Reproduce standby/wake with the inactive HDMI TV/receiver and capture display/work-area and window bounds before and after each handshake.
Trace FancyZones display-change/window relocation against OS taskbar work-area updates.
If ordering is confirmed, recompute against stable final topology instead of applying saved zones during an intermediate state.
Cover repeated topology notifications, inactive displays, and taskbar work-area changes.
verification: Repeat TV/receiver standby-wake and verify window positions, sizes, zoom and zone bounds remain valid.
Confirm final zones do not extend behind taskbar or use intermediate geometry.

confidence.rationale: The trigger and work-area follow-up are concrete, but available discussion does not isolate FancyZones from Windows topology/taskbar reporting.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones placement becomes unreliable when an inactive HDMI-connected TV/receiver changes standby state; a commenter also reports taskbar work-area symptoms after monitor transitions.
known_information: Reporter details PowerToys 0.79.0, primary display, and connected but unused secondary TV/AV receiver whose standby state triggers HDMI handshakes.
Placement, size/zoom and sometimes zone movement are affected; a PowerToys report ZIP is attached.
Three comments include taskbar reserved-space symptoms and a toggle workaround; latest reporter comment notes similar display transitions.
inferences: FancyZones may act on intermediate monitor/work-area geometry, but Windows taskbar behavior could explain part of the symptom.
issue_context.analysis: The existing topology sequence supports a maintainer reproduction; recording final monitor bounds and work area is more discriminating than a generic log request.
initial_investigation: Reviewed body and all three comments through 2024-04-17T12:26:54Z, including reporter's final note.
Taskbar toggle workaround suggests an OS work-area dimension but does not prove the FancyZones cause.
Product-FancyZones identifies ownership; no assignee or linked fix.

reproduce.title: Observe zones across TV/receiver standby
reproduce.version_requirement: Current development build; compare 0.79.0 if available
prerequisites: Primary display and HDMI-connected TV/AV receiver as secondary display
Secondary display connected but not active in desktop
setup: Record monitor/work-area geometry and taskbar configuration before testing.
steps: Note zone and window placement while TV/receiver is in standby.
Wake the TV/receiver; wait for Windows to settle and inspect monitor bounds, taskbar work area, window placement and zones.
Return it to standby and repeat; note whether any changed OS bounds precede FancyZones movement.
reproduce.expected_result: Placement follows final OS geometry after each handshake; no unexpected resize, shift or zones behind taskbar.
